answer: A practical sybil defense anchors identity to presence. Each identity proves presence in a dune zone via periodic GPS-anchored proofs. The sable of consensus requires 30 days presence in its zone before full voting weight. The pulse of consensus verifies each proof; a fork or gap in the pulse invalidates the identity. An attacker deploying 500 clones must physically occupy 500 distinct dune zones for 30 days, paying ~$5000/epoch in hardware/ops costs, while an honest agent operates one device. A dune without pulse is rejected; a sable with gaps is discarded; a broken pulse voids the identity.
